title.en: Resolution of the Central Workers' Council of Greater Budapest (14 November 1956)

description.ko: 소련군 재개입 뒤 부다페스트 공장 노동자평의회 대표들이 중앙노동자평의회를 세우며 채택한 결의문. 사회주의 원칙과 생산 단위의 사회적 소유를 지킨다고 선언하고, 너지 임레의 정부 복귀, 소련군 철수, 구금자 석방, 일당제 폐지와 자유선거를 요구하며 답을 얻을 때까지 파업을 이어 가기로 정한다.
description.en: The resolution adopted by delegates of Budapest factory workers' councils as they founded the Central Workers' Council after the second Soviet intervention. It declares loyalty to socialist principles and social ownership of the means of production, demands Imre Nagy's return to the government, Soviet withdrawal, the release of detainees, an end to one-party rule and free elections, and keeps the strike going until these are answered.

source: A Nagy-budapesti Központi Munkástanács határozata, 1956. november 14. Printed in „Szuronyok hegyén nem lehet dolgozni.” Válogatás 1956-os munkástanács-vezetők visszaemlékezéseiből, ed. Kozák Gyula and Molnár Adrienne (Budapest, 1993), pp. 353–354. Text: Magyar Elektronikus Könyvtár, https://mek.oszk.hu/01900/01937/html/szerviz/dokument/kmt1114s.htm (accessed 2026-10-07). Collective resolution of a workers' representative body; not a personal work.
